radix_economy.equation: E(R) = R / ln(R) (alternative form R/log2(R) for digit-count economics)

custom_ic_packaging.name: Hierarchical custom-IC macro-model requirements (Layer 2 composer)
custom_ic_packaging.fields: pins (name, direction, radix domain, voltage domain), internal netlist OR sub-IC references, extracted timing (input/output arcs), extracted dynamic power (switching activity × C·V²·f), parametric 3D package footprint (data/cad-specs/01_sky130_primitives_geometry.json schema)
custom_ic_packaging.extraction_contract: an IC is reusable only with an auto-extracted macro-model verified against its internal netlist solve (error tolerance in tests/master-plan-integrity.test.mjs: timing ±5%, energy ±10%)

equations: Q4 half adder: S = (A+B) mod 4, C = floor((A+B)/4)
